ABAddressBook.doc: The main object you use to access the Address Book database.

ABGroup.doc: An object that represents a group of records in the Address Book database.

ABMultiValue.doc: An immutable representation of a property that might have multiple values.

ABMutableMultiValue.doc: A mutable representation of a property that might have multiple values.

ABPerson.doc: An object that encapsulates all information about a person in the Address Book database.

ABRecord.doc: An abstract class that defines the common properties for all Address Book records.

ABSearchElement.doc: An object you use to specify a search query for records in the Address Book database.

ABImageClient.doc: Methods for responding to a request to load images associated with a contact.

+addressBook.doc: Returns a new instance of ABAddressBook, or nil if the Address Book database can’t be initialized.

+sharedAddressBook.doc: Returns the unique shared instance of ABAddressBook, or nil if the Address Book database can’t be initialized.

-addRecord:.doc: Adds an ABPerson or ABGroup record to the Address Book database.

-addRecord:error:.doc: Adds an ABPerson or ABGroup record to the Address Book database.

-defaultCountryCode.doc: Returns the default country code for records with unspecified country codes.

-defaultNameOrdering.doc: Returns the default name ordering defined by the user in the Address Book application’s preferences.

-formattedAddressFromDictionary:.doc: Returns an attributed string containing the formatted address.

-groups.doc: Returns an array of all the groups in the Address Book database.

-hasUnsavedChanges.doc: Indicates whether an address book has changes that have not been saved to the Address Book database.

-me.doc: Returns the ABPerson record that represents the logged-in user.

-people.doc: Returns an array of all the people in the Address Book database.

-recordClassFromUniqueId:.doc: Returns the class name of the record that matches the given unique ID.

-recordForUniqueId:.doc: Returns the person or group record that matches the given unique ID.

-recordsMatchingSearchElement:.doc: Returns an array of records that match the given search element, or returns an empty array if no records match the search element.

-removeRecord:.doc: Removes an ABPerson or ABGroup record from the Address Book database.

-removeRecord:error:.doc: Removes an ABPerson or ABGroup record from the Address Book database.

-save.doc: Saves all the changes made since the last save.

-saveAndReturnError:.doc: Saves all the changes made since the last save.

-setMe:.doc: Sets the record that represents the logged-in user.

+addPropertiesAndTypes:.doc: Adds the given properties to all records of this type in the Address Book database.

+properties.doc: Returns an array of the names of all the properties for this record type in the Address Book database.

+removeProperties:.doc: Removes the given properties from all the records of this type in the Address Book database.

+searchElementForProperty:label:key:valu.doc: Returns a search element object that searches for records of this type.

+typeOfProperty:.doc: Returns the type for a given property.

-addMember:.doc: Adds a person to a group.

-addSubgroup:.doc: Adds a subgroup to another group.

-distributionIdentifierForProperty:perso.doc: Returns the distribution identifier for the given property and person.

-members.doc: Returns an array of persons in a group.

-parentGroups.doc: Returns an array containing a group’s parents—that is, the groups that a group belongs to.

-removeMember:.doc: Removes a person from a group.

-removeSubgroup:.doc: Removes a subgroup from a group.

-setDistributionIdentifier:forProperty:p.doc: Assigns a specific distribution identifier for a person’s multivalue list property so that the group can be used as a distribution list.

-subgroups.doc: Returns an array containing a group’s subgroups.

-count.doc: Returns the number of entries in a multivalue list.

-identifierAtIndex:.doc: Returns the identifier for the given index.

-indexForIdentifier:.doc: Returns the index for the given identifier.

-labelAtIndex:.doc: Returns the label for the given index.

-labelForIdentifier:.doc: Returns the label for the given identifier.

-primaryIdentifier.doc: Returns the identifier for the primary value.

-propertyType.doc: Returns the type for the values in a multivalue list.

-valueAtIndex:.doc: Returns the value for the given index.

-valueForIdentifier:.doc: Returns the value for the given identifier.

-addValue:withLabel:.doc: Adds a value and its label to a multivalue list.

-insertValue:withLabel:atIndex:.doc: Inserts a value and its label at the given index in a multivalue list.

-removeValueAndLabelAtIndex:.doc: Removes the value and label at the given index.

-replaceLabelAtIndex:withLabel:.doc: Replaces the label at the given index.

-replaceValueAtIndex:withValue:.doc: Replaces the value at the given index.

-setPrimaryIdentifier:.doc: Sets the primary value to be the value for the given identifier.

+addPropertiesAndTypes:.doc: Adds the given properties to all the records of this type in the Address Book database.

+cancelLoadingImageDataForTag:.doc: Cancels an asynchronous fetch of the images for a given tag.

+properties.doc: Returns an array of the names of all the properties for the record in the Address Book database.

+removeProperties:.doc: Removes the given properties from all the records of this type in the Address Book database.

+searchElementForProperty:label:key:valu.doc: Returns a search element object that specifies a query for records of this type.

+typeOfProperty:.doc: Returns the type of a given property.

-beginLoadingImageDataForClient:.doc: Starts an asynchronous fetch for image data in all locations

-imageData.doc: Returns data that contains a picture of this person.

-linkedPeople.doc: Returns the array of all person records that are linked to the person this record represents.

-parentGroups.doc: Returns an array of the address book groups that this person belongs to.

-setImageData:.doc: Sets the image for this person to the given data.

-vCardRepresentation.doc: Returns the vCard representation of the person record as a data object in vCard format.

-init.doc: Initializes a record using the shared address book.

-initWithAddressBook:.doc: Initializes a record using the given address book.

-isReadOnly.doc: Returns whether a record is read-only.

-removeValueForProperty:.doc: Removes the value for a given property.

-setValue:forProperty:.doc: Sets the value of a given property for a record.

-setValue:forProperty:error:.doc: Sets the value of a given property for a record, returning error information.

-valueForProperty:.doc: Returns the value of a given property for a record.

+searchElementForConjunction:children:.doc: Returns a compound search element, created by combining the search elements in an array with the given conjunction.

-matchesRecord:.doc: Tests whether or not a record matches a search element.

init(VCardRepresentation:).doc: Returns an ABPerson instance initialized with the given data.

displayName.doc: A user-visible string representing the record.

uniqueId.doc: Returns the unique ID for a record.
